content:
omar (AE): ClearBank wants to start a 30-day POC but says they need compliance artifacts up front: SOC 2 Type II attestation, ISO27001 cert copy, a signed pen-test attestation (scope + signer), and a sanitized network diagram. They also asked if Dedicated is required to guarantee EU-only data residency and how much extra that would be for a short POC. Who can drive the doc bundle + presigned upload for them?

priya (SE): I can assemble the tech side and estimated delta for Dedicated. Quick clarification: we normally require an NDA before sharing the full SOC2 PDF. Can we share an attestation summary first? If they insist on Dedicated for residency, we need infra lead time for EU Dedicated pools.

lucas (Security): Standard practice: provide SOC2 attestation summary and ISO cert copy on request; full SOC2 report goes to dataroom post-NDA. Pen-test: we provide a signed attestation letter stating scope and date, not the raw findings. If ClearBank wants Dedicated in-scope for pen-test, that adds ~2 weeks and a small pen-test addendum. Signatory must be a named Security lead.

omar (AE): They asked for a presigned upload so their team can drop network diagrams and firewall rules. Can we give a 72h PUT presigned URL with SSE and no public ACL? They also want example ingress CIDRs to pre-configure their firewalls.

priya (SE): Yes to presigned PUT (72h, SSE-S3, private). Example curl I send:

curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: image/png" --data-binary @diagram.png

I'll provision dataroom DR-7711 and attach the link once it's ready. Need their primary contact email and intended filename layout. ETA: 3 hours to provision link and upload how-to.

lucas (Security): For ingress placeholders we can provide ephemeral ranges: 10.50.10.0/24 and 10.50.11.0/24. Those are placeholders until we map their staging VPC. Also: pen-test attestation must reference "model serving / inference runtime endpoints" explicitly if they want us to cover inference surface area.

infra-bot: DR-7711 created. Access: omar, priya, lucas. Presigned uploads enabled.

priya (SE): I'll prepare a short cost comparison: Hosted (token pricing + expected egress) vs Dedicated (reserved monthly pro-rate for POC) and call out SLA differences. Will drop in DR-7711 with the artifact checklist: SOC2 attestation pdf (post-NDA), ISO27001 cert, pen-test attestation pdf (signed), sanitized network diagram template, ingress CIDR doc.

omar (AE): Great. I'll ask ClearBank for the CISO name to sign the NDA/pen-test acceptance and confirm NDA timeline. If they can sign NDA same-day we can share full SOC2 via DR-7711. Will update thread. :pray:

lucas (Security): One more: if they request vulnerability details, we only share high-level remediation summaries. Full vuln report requires redaction + legal approval.

omar (AE): Understood. Thanks all. I'll ping when I have the signer and timeline.
